sn48.37:2.2: Yaṃ kho bhikkhave kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ kāyikaṃ sātaṃ kāyasamphassajaṃ sukhaṃ sātaṃ vedayitaṃ ||
sn48.37:6.2: Yaṃ kho bhikkhave kāyikaṃ vā cetasikaṃ vā neva sātaṃ nāsātaṃ vedayitaṃ ||
sn48.37:7.1: Tatra bhikkhave yaṃ ca sukhindriyaṃ yaṃ ca somanassindriyaṃ sukhā sā vedanā daṭṭhabbā || ||
sn48.37:7.2: Tatra bhikkhave yaṃ ca dukkhindriyam yaṃ ca domanassindriyaṃ dukkhā sā vedanā daṭṭhabbā || ||
sn48.37:7.3: Tatra bhikkhave yadidam upekhindriyam adukkhamasukhā sā vedanā daṭṭhabbā || || 9.
